_comment: slug -> keywords. 'cat:<slug>' entries tag a whole category; every prayer in that category inherits them into prayers_fts.cat_tags_s and the entry also becomes a Tier-2 category search result. A plain key is a literal prayers.slug ('categoryslug.restofslug', exactly as stored in prayers.sqlite) and tags only that one prayer's own tags_s. Every slug here is verified against Shared/prayers.sqlite by Tools/build_prayers_db.py, which fails the build on an unknown slug.
_format: value is a single space-separated string of modern-Russian words and short situations, written the way a user actually types them. See search_design.md §3.2 for the stemming gotcha (list an extra inflected form when Snowball splits a word's stem from its common inflections, e.g. `экзамен экзаменом`).
